events.headline: Two superpowered characters end a twelve-minute battle
consequences: Three bus routes have been suspended while engineers inspect the roads.
Hundreds of office workers have been told to work from home.
The local supermarket says deliveries are running several hours late.
A nearby school has moved classes online while the area is inspected.
Several apartment residents have been temporarily relocated.
npc_reactions: I was buying milk. Then the building across the street exploded.
They saved the city. I would like someone to save my apartment.
My office is still standing, but the road to it is not.
I don't know who won. I know my rent is still due.
I have absolutely no idea what happened. I just want the electricity back.

events.headline: Dungeon gate opens beside residential apartment complex
consequences: The subway station has been closed until the gate is declared safe.
Residents have been temporarily relocated to emergency accommodation.
Local restaurants report a sharp drop in customers.
Morning commuters are being redirected through a much longer route.
Several delivery companies have suspended service in the district.
npc_reactions: I have lived here for ten years. We never had a dungeon before.
My landlord says the apartment is safe. The giant monster outside disagrees.
My train was cancelled because apparently there is a monster on platform three.
I only wanted to go to work.
Can hunters please stop opening portals next to my building?

events.headline: Two martial sect leaders settle a dispute outside a tea shop
consequences: The market will remain closed while damaged stalls are rebuilt.
Merchants have moved their businesses to the east gate.
Tea supplies have been delayed because the main market road is blocked.
Local inn owners expect fewer visitors this week.
npc_reactions: They called it a friendly exchange. My shop is now two pieces.
I sell tea. I did not ask to become part of a martial arts duel.
Both masters walked away. My table did not.
The market was open this morning. That was nice while it lasted.
Could the next legendary battle happen somewhere that isn't my shop?

events.headline: Dragon attack ends after royal champion drives it beyond the walls
consequences: Northgate has closed its gates while the walls are repaired.
Farmers cannot bring produce into the city through the usual entrance.
The inn district is operating at reduced capacity.
Reconstruction crews have requested additional timber and stone.
npc_reactions: The dragon is gone. Unfortunately, so is my roof.
The champion saved us. I am grateful. I would also like my shop back.
We have survived three dragon attacks this year. I think we need better insurance.
The castle still has a roof. Mine does not.
I don't care who won. Someone needs to repair my chimney.
